paper.title: Large Language Monkeys : Scaling Inference Compute with Repeated Sampling

result.summary: 本文研究将推理阶段的计算量作为新的扩展维度，通过重复采样（repeated sampling）从语言模型生成大量候选解来提升推理性能 [S1.p3]。作者在 GSM8K、MATH、MiniF2F-MATH、CodeContests 和 SWE-bench Lite 五个任务上，用 Llama-3、Gemma、Pythia、DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 等模型生成最多 10,000 个样本，发现覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级上提升，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。在有自动验证器的编码和形式证明任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升，例如 SWE-bench Lite 上 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56%，超过 43% 的单样本 SOTA [S1.p8]。但在没有自动验证器的数学应用题中，多数投票和奖励模型等常见验证方法在约 100 个样本后趋于饱和，无法充分利用覆盖率提升 [S1.p10][S4.SS1.p3]。

research_question.text: 论文旨在系统性地刻画重复采样作为推理计算扩展手段的收益，即随着样本数增加，模型能解决多大比例的问题（覆盖率），以及能否从大量样本中识别出正确解（精确率）[S1.p3][S1.p5]。作者指出，尽管训练计算扩展已被广泛研究，推理阶段的计算投入相对有限，用户和开发者常限制模型只做一次尝试 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.

1. Coverage: As the number of samples increases, what fraction of problems can we solve using any sample that was generated? 2. Precision: How often can we identify correct samples from our collection of generations?
However, when interacting with LLMs, users and developers often restrict models to making only one attempt when solving a problem.

method.text: 论文采用重复采样方法：对每个问题用正温度从语言模型独立生成大量候选解，再用领域特定的验证器（如代码的单元测试、Lean4 证明检查器）从样本中选出最终答案 [S1.F1]。覆盖率用 pass@k 的无偏估计公式计算，即至少一个样本正确的概率 [S2.p5][S2.p6]。作者还用指数幂律 log(c) ≈ a k^b 对覆盖率与样本数的关系建模 [S3.SS1.p1]。

evidence.quote: 1) We generate many independent candidate solutions for a given problem by sampling from an LLM with a positive temperature. 2) We use a domain-specific verifier (ex. unit tests for code) to select a final answer from the generated samples.
In coding settings, our definition of coverage is equivalent to the commonly-used pass@k metric, where $k$ denotes the number of samples per problem.
pass@k $\displaystyle=\frac{1}{\text{\# of problems}}\sum_{i=1}^{\text{\# of problems}}\left(1-\frac{\binom{N-C_{i}}{k}}{\binom{N}{k}}\right)$
We start by adopting the same function class, but now modelling the log of coverage $c$ as a function of the number of samples $k$: $\displaystyle\log(c)\approx ak^{b}$

experiments.text: 论文在五个任务上评估：GSM8K 和 MATH 各取 128 个随机测试题，MiniF2F-MATH 取 130 个形式化 MATH 问题，CodeContests 取 140 个无图像标签的测试题，SWE-bench Lite 用 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 配合 Moatless Tools 框架 [S2.p4][S2.SS1.p1]。对 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 和 Llama-3-70B-Instruct 在 CodeContests、MiniF2F、GSM8K、MATH 上每个问题生成 10,000 个独立样本，SWE-bench Lite 限制为 250 次尝试 [S2.SS1.p1]。此外还在 Llama 3、Gemma、Pythia 等不同规模（70M-70B）和训练阶段的模型上，于 MATH 和 CodeContests 上验证趋势 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: 1. GSM8K: A dataset of grade-school level math word problems. We evaluate on a random subset of 128 problems from the GSM8K test set.

3. MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset.
4. CodeContests: A dataset of competitive programming problems.
5. SWE-bench Lite: A dataset of real world Github issues, where each problem consists of a description and a snapshot of a code repository.
We evaluate Llama-3-8B-Instruct and Llama-3-70B-Instruct on CodeContests, MiniF2F, GSM8K, and MATH, generating 10,000 independent samples per problem.
For SWE-bench Lite, we use DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct, as the required context length of this task exceeds the limits of the Llama-3 models.
To minimize costs, we restrict the number of attempts per issue to 250, with all attempts made independently of one another.
• Llama 3: Llama-3-8B, Llama-3-8B-Instruct, Llama-3-70B-Instruct. • Gemma: Gemma-2B, Gemma-7B. • Pythia: Pythia-70M through Pythia-12B (eight models in total).
We restrict evaluation to the MATH and CodeContests datasets to minimize inference costs, reporting results in Figure 3.

findings.text: 覆盖率随样本数在四个数量级上提升，且常可用指数幂律建模 [S1.p7][S3.p2]。在有自动验证器的任务中，覆盖率提升直接转化为性能提升：SWE-bench Lite 上 DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct 从单样本 15.9% 提升到 250 样本的 56%，超过 43% 的单样本 SOTA [S1.p8]。弱模型加多样本可超过强模型单样本，例如 Llama-3-8B-Instruct 在竞争性编程和 Lean 证明上可超过 GPT-4o 的单样本表现 [S1.p8]。在无自动验证器的 MATH 上，多数投票和奖励模型在约 100 个样本后饱和，覆盖率从 100 样本的 82.9% 升到 10,000 样本的 98.44%，但最佳选择方法仅从 40.50% 升到 41.41% [S1.p10]。

evidence.quote: we find that sampling up to 10,000 times per problem can significantly boost coverage on math and coding tasks
1. The relationship between coverage and the number of samples can often be modelled with an exponentiated power law.

When restricted to a single sample, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Instruct solves only 15.9% of issues. By simply increasing the number of samples to 250, we increase the fraction of solved issues to 56%, exceeding the state-of-the-art by 13%.
When applying repeated sampling to competitive programming and writing Lean proofs, models like Llama-3-8B-Instruct can exceed the single-sample performance of much stronger ones like GPT-4o.
When solving MATH problems with Llama-3-8B-Instruct, coverage increases from 82.9% with 100 samples to 98.44% with 10,000 samples.
However, when using majority voting or reward models to select final answers, the biggest performance increase is only from 40.50% to 41.41% over the same sample range.
While success rates initially increase with the number of samples for all three methods, they plateau around 100 samples.

limitations.text: 作者承认实验只探索了最简单的重复采样形式，即所有尝试使用完全相同的提示和超参数独立生成，未利用解多样性、多轮交互或从先前尝试中学习 [S5.p2][S5.p3]。在无自动验证器的领域，常见验证方法（多数投票和奖励模型）在约 100 个样本后饱和，无法随样本预算扩展，作者强调改进样本验证方法的重要性 [S5.p5]。此外，软件任务的验证器存在缺陷：SWE-bench Lite 中 11.3% 的问题有 flaky 测试，CodeContests 中 122 个有 Python3 解的问题里有 35 个的“正确”解无法通过测试 [S4.SS2.SSS1.p1][S4.SS2.SSS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: In our experiments, we explore only a simple version of repeated sampling where all attempts to a problem are generated independently of one another using the exact same prompt and hyperparameters.
1. Solution Diversity: We currently rely on a positive sampling temperature as the sole mechanism for creating diversity among samples.

2. Multi-Turn Interactions: Despite automatic verification tools being available when solving CodeContests and MiniF2F problems, we use only a single-turn setup where models generate a solution without any ability to iterate on it.
3. Learning From Previous Attempts: Currently, our experiments fully isolate attempts from each other.
Our results from Section 4 highlight the importance of improving sample verification methods when tools for automatically doing so are unavailable.
When producing our results on SWE-bench Lite, we identified that 11.3% of problems have flaky test suites that do not produce consistent results when running them on the same candidate solution.
Of the 122 problems in the test set that have Python3 solutions, we find that 35 problems have “correct” solutions that fail the corresponding tests.
